title: Local is reachable here only; failed server URLs name why
form: CLI output, dashboard footer and connection errors
verification: Focused tests cover `yoke status` (`local: reachable here only`, `project: no project here`), the dashboard footer and named team-server failures (server_name_unresolved, server_timed_out, server_refused, server_https_failed, server_not_yoke, server_unreachable) that point to `yoke status` on the server's machine; a 4xx web page instead of Yoke's JSON (for example upyoke.com's HTTP 405) is server_not_yoke and names the hosted app URL, and `yoke connect https://upyoke.com` or www.upyoke.com starts hosted approval; no installed-release capture yet.
